Normalize a target list data frame to a standard schema

Source: R/normalize_target_list.R
normalize_target_list.Rd

Accepts target lists from different sources and maps heterogeneous column names to a unified schema with columns: Name, Formula, exactMass, [M+H]+, [M-H]-, and optionally RT.

Supported input column name variants:

Name

CNAME, Name

Formula

FORMULA, Formula, Formula (as seen in ...), any column starting with "Formula"

exactMass

exactMass, MONO_MASS, Neutral mass, Neutral.mass

M+H+

M+H+, M+H, MH, MplusH

M-H-

M-H-, M-H, MH_neg, MminusH

RT

RT, RetentionTime, rt

If [M+H]+ or [M-H]- are absent but exactMass is present, the ion m/z values are computed automatically.

Usage

normalize_target_list(target_list)

Arguments

target_list

A data.frame or tibble target list

Value

A data.frame with standardized column names
